### call 1: node=spark-1 timeout=35 check=False
set -eu
if ! systemctl --user show dgx-model-production.service >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf '%s\n' 'already-stopped'
  exit 0
fi
systemctl --user stop --no-block dgx-model-production.service || true
deadline=$((SECONDS + 30))
while systemctl --user is-active --quiet dgx-model-production.service; do
  if [ "$SECONDS" -ge "$deadline" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'stop-timeout' >&2
    exit 75
  fi
  sleep 1
done
printf '%s\n' 'stopped'
### call 2: node=spark-1 timeout=12.5 check=False
set -eu
if ! systemctl --user show dgx-model-production.service >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf '%s\n' 'already-stopped'
  exit 0
fi
systemctl --user stop --no-block dgx-model-production.service || true
systemctl --user kill --kill-whom=all --signal=KILL dgx-model-production.service 2>/dev/null || true
deadline=$((SECONDS + 7))
while systemctl --user is-active --quiet dgx-model-production.service; do
  if [ "$SECONDS" -ge "$deadline" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'stop-timeout' >&2
    exit 75
  fi
  sleep 1
done
printf '%s\n' 'stopped'
### end
